name: Ezekiel
title: The Prophet in Babylon
summary: Ezekiel was a priest and prophet who ministered among the Jewish exiles in Babylon. He is known for his dramatic visions and symbolic actions. His book contains the vision of God's throne, the valley of dry bones coming to life, and the future temple—images of God's glory and Israel's restoration.

keyEvents.title: The Call at the Kebar
keyEvents.description: By the river Kebar, Ezekiel saw a powerful vision of God's throne carried by four living creatures and wheels, and was called to be a prophet.

keyEvents.title: Watchman for Israel
keyEvents.description: God appointed Ezekiel as watchman for Israel with the responsibility to warn the people of the coming judgment.

keyEvents.title: Jerusalem's Fall Proclaimed
keyEvents.description: Through dramatic symbolic actions, Ezekiel proclaimed Jerusalem's upcoming siege and fall.

keyEvents.title: The Valley of Dry Bones
keyEvents.description: Ezekiel saw a valley full of dry bones that came to life when he prophesied—an image of Israel's restoration.

keyEvents.title: The New Temple
keyEvents.description: Ezekiel received a detailed vision of the future temple and God's glory returning.
